rows.label: qst620502_msg0005
rows.name:
We cannot contain it alone! Please
lend us your help!

rows.label: qst620502_msg0007
rows.name: So this is what Ibuki heard about.

rows.label: qst620502_msg0010
rows.name: This is no time to play the fool!

rows.label: qst620502_msg0011
rows.name:
Ibuki probably heard at the inn that a
rebellion would break out inside the
palace.

rows.label: qst620502_msg0012
rows.name: And because you told us so quickly...

rows.label: qst620502_msg0013
rows.name:
We were able to arrive right after the
rebellion began.

rows.label: qst620502_msg0016
rows.name:
Zeke-sama, the rebel soldiers are
heading for the door that won't open
beyond Snow-White Passage.

rows.label: qst620502_msg0017
rows.name:
All right. I'll give them a painful
lesson.

rows.label: qst620502_msg0018
rows.name:
Yeah... We can work out the details
later. For now, let us focus on
suppressing the rebellion.
